items.title: Unit 6 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
Let's play after school this week, Alice! Good idea! Can you play on Monday?

Sorry, no. I have a music lesson every Monday. How about Tuesday?

I visit my grandma every Tuesday. Wednesday?

Well, I don't have a music lesson. But I help my mum. Thursday?

I go swimming every Thursday. Oh dear.

Hello, girls. Alice can go swimming with us! Thanks, Mum!
